name: Joint Entrance Examination (Main)
conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA), Government of India
scope: National-level engineering entrance exam for admission to NITs, IIITs, CFTIs and qualifying candidates for JEE (Advanced)
exam_frequency: Twice a year (two sessions: January and April)

paper2a.name: Paper 2A (B.Arch.)
paper2a.mode: Mathematics and Aptitude in CBT; Drawing Test in pen-and-paper (offline) on A4 sheet

eligibility.age_limit: No age restriction for JEE (Main). Candidates who have passed class 12 / equivalent in 2024, 2025, or appearing in 2026 are eligible.
eligibility.qualifying_examination: Class 12 / equivalent (AICTE-recognised) with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics as compulsory subjects
eligibility.number_of_attempts: For JEE (Main) 2026, eligible candidates are those who passed Class 12 / equivalent in 2024 or 2025, or are appearing in 2026.

reservation_eligibility.general: All Indian nationals / OCI / PIO / Foreign nationals meeting qualifying criteria
reservation_eligibility.obc_ncl: Certificate valid as per central list on the last date of registration
reservation_eligibility.ews: Income and asset certificate as per central format
reservation_eligibility.pwd: Minimum 40% disability; certificate with UDID / Form issued by notified medical authority

reservations.pwd: 5% horizontal reservation for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) across all categories

single_paper.description: Paper 1 OR Paper 2A OR Paper 2B (any one)

application_fee_inr.note: Service charges/processing fees of payment gateway extra. Fee non-refundable.

exam_timing.first_shift: 09:00 AM – 12:00 Noon IST (3-hour paper) / 09:00 AM – 12:30 PM IST (3.5-hour paper)
exam_timing.second_shift: 03:00 PM – 06:00 PM IST (3-hour paper) / 03:00 PM – 06:30 PM IST (3.5-hour paper)
exam_timing.duration: Paper 1 / Paper 2A / Paper 2B = 3 hours; B.Arch + B.Planning together = 3 hours 30 minutes

admission_use.nit_iiit_cfti: JEE (Main) score is used for admission to NITs, IIEST, IIITs and Other-GFTIs through JoSAA / CSAB seat allocation process
admission_use.iit_qualifying: Top 2,50,000 (approx.) candidates in Paper 1 qualify for JEE (Advanced), subject to category-wise eligibility criteria
admission_use.other_institutions: Many state-level and private engineering colleges also use JEE (Main) score for admission

normalization: NTA uses percentile-based normalization (N = 100 x Number of candidates with raw score <= candidate's score / Total number of candidates in that shift).
answer_key_challenges: Provisional answer keys are displayed on the NTA website; candidates may challenge within the notified window with a non-refundable fee per question.
